passive.name: Organic Deconstruction
passive.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply <keywordName>Organic Deconstruction</keywordName> to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

spells.name: Plasma Fission
spells.description: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.
spells.tooltip:
Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slowamount*100 }}% decaying over {{ slowduration }} second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle.

Killing a unit with this restores {{ tooltipmanarefund }} Mana.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Void Rift
spells.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.
spells.tooltip:
Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing {{ initialdamage }} magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing {{ secondarydamage }} magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges ({{ ammorechargetime }} second refresh).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tectonic Disruption
spells.description: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.
spells.tooltip: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, <status>Knocking Up</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be <status>Knocked Back</status> instead of <status>Knocked Up</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
spells.description: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.
spells.tooltip:
Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by {{ e3 }}%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by Organic Deconstruction.

Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Organic Deconstruction
effects: Innate: Vel'Koz's abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction to enemies hit for 7 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
The third stack consumes them all to deal 35 : 180 (based on level) (+ 60% AP) bonus true damage.

variants.name: Plasma Fission
effects: Recast: Vel'Koz splits the bolt in two over 0.25 seconds, each part firing perpendicularly in opposite directions and applying the same effects to enemies hit.

variants.name: Void Rift
effects: Vel'Koz periodically stocks a Void Rift charge, up to a maximum of 2.

variants.name: Tectonic Disruption
effects: If Tectonic Disruption is cast in close proximity of Vel'Koz, the anomaly will also slightly knock back enemies hit in the direction of the cast.

variants.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
effects: Passive - Researched: Applying 3 Deconstruction stacks to an enemy champion marks them as Researched for 7 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and ability hits against them.

Active: After a 0.2-second delay, Vel'Koz channels for up to 2.6 seconds to project an energy beam, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. Life Form Disintegration Ray can be recast after 1 second during the channel, and does so automatically after the duration.
Recast: Vel'Koz ends Life Form Disintegration Ray.
